name: Switzerland Romantic Escape
summary: Seven days built around Switzerland's most romantic set pieces: Lucerne's medieval lakefront, two nights between Interlaken's lakes, the train to Europe's highest station at Jungfraujoch, and the GoldenPass panorama down to Montreux and Chillon Castle. Slow trains, big windows, no rushing.
highlights: Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe at 3,454 m
GoldenPass panoramic train from Interlaken to Montreux
Chapel Bridge and a Lake Lucerne cruise
Chillon Castle on the Lake Geneva shore

itinerary.title: Arrive & Lucerne
itinerary.description: Land at Zurich, train to Lucerne, first walk across the flower-lined Chapel Bridge and through the old town.

itinerary.title: Mt. Pilatus golden round trip
itinerary.description: Lake boat out, the world's steepest cogwheel railway up, cable car down — Lucerne's classic day, ending with a lakeside dinner.

itinerary.title: To Interlaken
itinerary.description: Train into the Bernese Oberland, afternoon cruise on Lake Brienz, sunset funicular to Harder Kulm.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: The big one: rail via Kleine Scheidegg to Europe's highest station — Ice Palace, Sphinx terrace, and the Aletsch Glacier below.

itinerary.title: GoldenPass to Montreux
itinerary.description: Panoramic carriages from chalet country down to Lake Geneva's vineyard shore; evening promenade in Montreux.

itinerary.title: Chillon & lake day
itinerary.description: Morning at the moated Chillon Castle, lazy lakeside afternoon — or an optional Glacier Express taster via the mountains.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Train to Geneva or Zurich for the flight home.
